long_biography.plain_text:
Massimo Malgorani co-founded Deltaomega in Milan in 1983 to distribute automation components and systems. Fifteen years later, he narrowed the business to the growing micromotor sector and created Delta Line. An exclusive Italian distribution arrangement expanded across Europe, giving the company a technical-commercial network beyond its original domestic base.

Acquiring shares in China-based Fulling Motor gave Delta Line production capacity for motors and gearboxes. The group later moved its global headquarters to Switzerland and added in-house engineering. As president, Malgorani has continued expanding through North American operations, integrated motion systems and co-ownership of an Italian electronics manufacturer. Delta Line now combines its own design resources with manufacturing partners across three continents.
long_biography.html:
Massimo Malgorani co-founded Deltaomega in Milan in 1983 to distribute automation components and systems. Fifteen years later, he narrowed the business to the growing micromotor sector and created Delta Line. An exclusive Italian distribution arrangement expanded across Europe, giving the company a technical-commercial network beyond its original domestic base.

Acquiring shares in China-based Fulling Motor gave Delta Line production capacity for motors and gearboxes. The group later moved its global headquarters to Switzerland and added in-house engineering. As president, Malgorani has continued expanding through North American operations, integrated motion systems and co-ownership of an Italian electronics manufacturer. Delta Line now combines its own design resources with manufacturing partners across three continents.
